Article: (CNN)Her murder shocked a nation, but according to the slain woman's father, it also woke Turkey up. Ozgecan Aslan's body was found last month, burned and abandoned, just days after her family reported her missing. She allegedly fought off a sexual assault before being killed by the driver of a bus 

Summary: Ozgecan Aslan allegedly fought off a sexual assault before being killed .
Her death triggered widespread protests, including one on International Women's Day .
